question: Why do only some of the 25 graded Fe I lines in the CRIRES+ H band carry a Gerber NLTE departure, and is the shortfall a fixable labelling defect or a deck limit?

headline.classification: ALL 13 unlabelled lines are TRANSITION-ABSENT from atom.fe607a. Zero labelling defects. Zero level-absent.
headline.fixable_by: a larger model atom — the deck would have to carry these bound-bound transitions. Nothing in this repo can add them.

correction_to_rya1203.why: pool_label_coverage credits a line with ANY labelled row within 0.05 A. Fe I 16179.583 (the graded Ruffoni line, log gf +0.261) is nlte=F with no labels; the label 0.026 A away belongs to a DIFFERENT Fe I line at log gf -2.227 — 2.5 dex weaker, a w5G4*-f5G4 transition against the target's own. Counting it credits the target with its blend neighbour's physics (RYA-1037: a wavelength is not a key).
correction_to_rya1203.consequence: the honest genuinely-NLTE count is 12, so the emitted product is n=12, not n=13.

method.label_source: data/linelists/ispec_h_15007_17494/atomic_lines.tsv — the list the synthesis actually reads
method.atom: /mnt/codex-ext/codex-grids/nlte/gerber_ts/atom.fe607a (607 levels, 12635 radiative transitions; header cut: log gf > -5, lambda < 20000 A)
method.matching: against the atom's OWN transition records (`* i = N <lambda> log_gf = <g> <low> <up>`), on lambda AND log gf together. Lambda alone would have claimed 8 of the 13 unlabelled lines are in the atom; every one of those 8 is a different transition, up to 3.7 dex off in log gf.

why_not_level_absent.lower_levels: present — 84 Fe I levels sit in the 6.25-6.50 eV bin the unlabelled lines' EPs fall in
why_not_level_absent.upper_levels: present — each unlabelled line needs an upper level near 7.03-7.09 eV and the atom has 5d5S 7.032, 6p5F* 7.082, 6s3F 7.089, matching to 0.004 eV
why_not_level_absent.conclusion: both levels exist for all 13; it is the TRANSITION between them that the deck does not carry.

the_boundary.note: the two sets INTERLEAVE in wavelength (15051 in, 15080 out, 15207 in, 15591 out...), which is what proves the limit is not a wavelength cut. The atom carries 765 transitions inside 15007-17494 A; the 12 graded lines it covers are the whole e7D-n7D* multiplet.

cross_check_vs_engine_a_rya1165.engine_a_H_coverage: 0 of 20 — MPIA grid edge between 12648.742 and 15051.700 A (measured RYA-1203)
cross_check_vs_engine_a_rya1165.raw_overlap: 13 of 13 Gerber-unlabelled lines are also ENGINE-A-unserved = 100%
cross_check_vs_engine_a_rya1165.verdict: DEGENERATE, and reporting it as agreement would be wrong. ENGINE-A serves NOTHING in this band, so the unserved set is the whole band and every subset overlaps it 100%. An overlap with a universal set carries no information.
cross_check_vs_engine_a_rya1165.answer: NOT a shared physical limit and NOT one defect starving both. The two limits have DIFFERENT SHAPES: ENGINE-A's is a wavelength boundary that drops all 20 regardless of excitation; Gerber's is a transition-content boundary that selects by EP (5.31-5.43 in, 6.24-6.35 out) and interleaves in wavelength. In the H band the engines are COMPLEMENTARY, not co-limited — Gerber reaches 12 lines MPIA cannot touch at all.

how_25_becomes_9: 25 graded Ruffoni Fe I lines in 15007.11-17493.69 A
23 enter the candidate pool (theoretical-depth and 4 A min-separation filters)
11 of those 23 carry a genuine NLTE label; 12 do not and are excluded as NO-NLTE-LABEL
2 of the 11 fitted lines are excluded as SYNTHESIS: edge_pinned
9 in the aggregate; n_excluded = 14 = 12 unlabelled + 2 edge-pinned
emitted_product.per_line_evidence: all 23 rows are present in the _lines.csv. The 12 unlabelled ones carry abundance = null -- there is no NLTE value for a line the deck cannot treat, and copying the LTE number across would manufacture exactly the mislabelled value the exclusion exists to prevent.
emitted_product.they_cannot_be_fitted_only_recorded: leaving them in the pool does not produce LTE-valued NLTE rows: _fit_synth_flux calls assert_linelist_supports_nlte per WINDOW and raises GerberDeckError ('4 lines in 15078.3-15082.1 A but NONE carry NLTE level labels'). That guard is correct; it is why the pool is narrowed for the FIT and the excluded lines are re-attached as rows afterwards.
emitted_product.nlte_effect: NOT COMPUTABLE for this product. The -0.003 dex against the 1D-LTE sibling is atmosphere + departures COMBINED, not the NLTE effect, which requires the Gerber-LTE leg on the SAME atmosphere (RYA-542/1040). H has no synth-1D-LTE-gerber product, and RYA-1083 forbids differencing the two published values. Reported as unavailable rather than estimated.
